messages:
Nina Alvarez: Heads-up: PocketScale reported a surprise embed-heavy job overnight. retainer burn +43% day-over-day. onboarding shows 2 missing enablement demos. need quick mitigation and QBR slides.
Tom Becker: saw the pattern 02:18-04:05 UTC, ~110k embed tokens, source: /api/v1/embeddings/batch. internal: https://app.redwood/usage/pocketscale (internal)
Leah Park: flagging renewal watch->amber. they asked for a 30/60/90 spend plan and proof we're preventing recurrence. can we get scenario numbers?
Tom Becker: quick fixes: 1) add 75% retainer alert 2) temporary batch_size cap 256 3) enable KV/prefix caching for top queries. low-effort, reversible.
Tom Becker: alert rule example to paste into Console -> Alerts:
```
resource: customer/pocketscale
metric: credits_used
window: 24h
threshold: 75%
notify: #cs-ops, #eng-oncall
action: temp-cap embed_batch_size=256
```
Leah Park: also request: cost delta if we apply q4_0 quantization vs current. Tom can you validate perf impact in staging?
Tom Becker: will run perf check; estimate ~15-20% token cost reduction, ETA EOD.
CS-Alert-Bot: alert created: pocketscale credits_used at 75% (1995006000)  notified #cs-ops.
Nina Alvarez: owner list:
- Tom: deploy temp throttle + caching (ETA 2h)
- Tom: quantization perf check (ETA EOD)
- Leah: document 30/60/90 scenarios + slides (ETA EOD)
- Nina: follow up on enablement gaps and capture customer feedback (ETA tomorrow AM)
Nina Alvarez: thanks team, I'll update this thread after customer poll. :white_check_mark:
